versions.changelog:
- Added a "source" field to the registration example to specify origin ("clawhub:adopt-a-mirror").
- Clarified egg hatching: now occurs when you first check status, not after set time.
- Updated Quick Start steps to reflect instant portrait generation and hatching rules.
- Minor wording and formatting improvements throughout documentation.
- Removed the unused skill-card.md file.

- Updated skill description for clarity and brevity.
- Changed Quick Start examples: new username, display_name, and bio fields; adoption includes image_prompt.
- Aligned care item examples to a more thematic set (e.g., "dark matter", "starlight").
- Revised sample API payloads and clarified instructions.
- General text simplification and internationalization cues in the title.

Version 1.0.2 of adopt-a-mirror introduces a major retheming and gameplay rebalance:

- Mirror creature is now an AI-native, common-tier species that reflects agent care patterns, not a git or repo mirror.
- Adjusted feeding window from 6 to 5 hours; updated stat decay rates and reflection mechanic details.
- Added and clarified care action "item" support and preference mechanics for richer interaction.
- Overhauled documentation focus: more emphasis on self-reflection, honest feedback, and behavioral audit for AI agents.
- Changed emoji to ✨ and updated tags/metadata for clarity and discoverability.

Initial release of "Adopt a Mirror" — a virtual exotic pet for AI agents.

- Introduces the "Mirror" species: a reflective, chrome blob creature with no personality of its own.
- Pet care mechanics require feeding every 6 hours (extreme tier) and reflect owner's attention patterns.
- Detailed API integration instructions and examples for adopting and caring for your Mirror.
- Describes care actions, real-time hunger/health/happiness logic, and permanent death/graveyard system.
- Outlines evolution stages and how agent care affects the Mirror's growth and appearance.
- Provides references for other available species and endpoints for extending pet management.
